residency_notes: MiniMax's current API privacy policy says personal data is stored in data centers in the United States. The platform also distinguishes mainland-China and overseas/global service regions, but the public API materials do not provide a general Zero Data Retention control or a model execution-location guarantee; Lightning uses the same platform policy.
prompt_training_notes: MiniMax's Open Platform Terms say MiniMax may use input and generated content to provide, maintain, develop, and improve its services. The public API policy does not provide a general no-training or zero-retention guarantee; Lightning is the priority offer on the same platform.
